Qwen3-8B-Base (8-bit), small-item bin-packing family. Transfer measured on 8 held-out variants (never in any training set), test instances (20 x 200 items, seeds 200+). mean/best = test excess over the lower bound of valid candidates; rel = mean excess minus min(best fit, first fit); find = share beating min(BF, FF) on the variant's own training instances by 0.001; distinct = distinct/valid; copy = share identical (normalized) to a function in the arm's SFT set of that cycle.
